## Basis and independence

Independent nonauthor reviewed the complete delivered implementation from cf6ed229b8314727f47c6dbe387510b4f6f548ac through engineering 09c1d089d02ae0ef53a03fe668c91d9c20563b8a, including corrections previously inspected before final proof. I authored no engineering, tests, plan or model. Prior independent Delivery and Design assessment authorship is not implementation authorship. This milestone judgment does not substitute for the mandatory subsequent final whole-change checkpoint.

Design r2 normative Release/guidance members, Delivery r5 exact primary plan 4582fbd6a9953be83686e64ecf803ff803b1c787f8dce779c97bd94f79ba47e3 and applicable CLI/Workflow contracts were checked against actual bytes. Model-author registration alignment changes no Design bytes or original judgment. Older contextual source/plan hashes and old reviews remain historical observations, not silently current runtime proof. Current implementation evidence m1-implementation matches all 28 observed subjects. The recording suffix after engineering contains evidence/routing only and does not retarget the runtime pass to changed engineering.

## Implementation and cross-boundary assessment

Shared check-ci preparation precedes both existing PR selected and main direct dispatch. It uses existing candidate preparation/full verification, a clone of exact S, generated C, and the actual packed package overlay; original authored release files are not filled with fabricated results. Effective source range resolves before moving into C; repeated head arguments normalize and main defaults still refer to S. Child snapshot readers receive C with unchanged original base. Reentry verifies C, and post-child checks revalidate original S binding, full source status, declared overlay bytes and every packed runtime file. The ignored-runtime negative independently exercises the tarball check. Child failure 3 cannot turn into the source-mode sentinel.

Offline intent validates the current stable package and closed decision/rationale without pretending to observe the published version. CI-only inputs are sealed and explicitly denied publication approval. Existing hosted resolution still requires actual public version and increment agreement; publisher/provider/workflow authority is unchanged. No new public command, runner, check ID, publication path, credential fallback or real publication is introduced. Temporary candidate proofs are local execution evidence, not reusable publication authority.

Current release validation verifies the candidate and actual prepared receipt only for its current tag; other versions retain recorded-source behavior. Lifecycle's narrow pending-preflight allowance requires exact workspace and verified CI-only candidate tag/C. Other records and absent context remain strict. Failed/unknown/missing/duplicate gates, emergency rules and public registry outcomes are not relaxed. Invalid candidate context produces a bounded error. The main and selected graphs actually exercised these integrated readers on generated C.

Current package fixture expectations now follow the package under test while historical/incompatible cases stay fixed. The historical full candidate scenario pins its own 0.5.1 package/lock; current 1.0.0 proof still builds real metadata, archives and installed package. Output-fixture adaptation changes only current identity fields and retains exact shapes. Unknown-field substitutions continue to change the fixture, preserving negative detection. No tests were removed.

Discovery now performs safe structural classification before applying current candidate grammar. Explicit invalid IDs still reject before repository access; archive/noncurrent exclusions do not decode history. Malformed current, mixed manifests, reserved residue, unsafe paths and symlinks retain rejection. BAD/OTHER negative fixtures now contain current manifests, preserving their actual intended contract. The archival ledger is untouched; one explicit catalog disposition preserves every other coverage/unique-owner condition, and separate current retirement proof is executed. Existing record-retirement selection now owns changed ledger/helper paths and runs the actual Python suite through a repository-only Node test with nonzero propagation. No broad ignored-ID exception or historical behavior equivalence claim was added.

CI-maintenance review finds both graphs retain their checks and failure propagation; required broad smoke was selected and executed, not suppressed for this release. Dry-run/selector fixture modes remain existing nonexecuting test boundaries. No hosted trigger, permission, cache or publisher changes occur in this implementation. The current plan navigation correction places the initiative in Current rather than Done and does not own mutable routing state.

## Direct evidence and limitations

Observed final logs for both actual commands: bash scripts/ci.sh --mode pr --base cf6ed229b8314727f47c6dbe387510b4f6f548ac --head 09c1d089d02ae0ef53a03fe668c91d9c20563b8a; and the same command with --mode main. Both exited 0 per durable implementation evidence and terminate in matching pass summaries. PR includes required broad_smoke.repo and all selected checks; main completes all 28 direct gates, including its final lifecycle check. Both identify prepared C 776e14d5b5930924d3e36bfc25be2c1036de2ee9 from exact S; distinct candidate identities reflect separate executions, not a single silently reused receipt. Full builder checks, actual archives/package and supported target consumers ran before ordinary CI. Logs are /tmp/release-integration-pr6.log and /tmp/release-integration-main6.log; durable evidence retains source/identity/result claims without requiring those temporary paths for meaning.

Reviewer independently ran 33 Candidate/Approval/Coordination tests: pass in 1.882s. Earlier bounded reviewer checks ran actual Python ledger 17 tests and both new lifecycle regressions successfully. Read final selector routing, preservation and tamper/failure tests plus actual full-run results; helper tests are not substituted for final PR/main composition. Earlier failed/interrupted runs remain failed/interrupted in evidence, including the raw four-check failure, historical fixture mismatch, pending S snapshot/discovery blockers and last selector/lifecycle integration errors. Those observations explain corrections without claiming earlier completion.

Final source/record validation follows this save. No hosted CI success, OIDC publication authorization, customer installation, version publication, final Verify or PR readiness is asserted. Final whole-change assessment and distinct Verify remain separate route-owned stages; a future merged release must prepare a fresh publishable candidate.
